text: The Savings Deposit Insurance Fund (TMSF) is a Turkish public legal entity with administrative and financial autonomy, established to protect financial stability and deposit holders; court-appointed trusteeship over companies is one of its functions.
short: TMSF is a Turkish public legal entity with trusteeship duties

source.name: Emlak Katılım Bankası: TMSF Güvencesi
source.quote: Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu (TMSF/Fon), kamu tüzel kişiliğine sahip, idari ve mali özerkliği bulunan bir kuruluştur.
source.note: Same page: TMSF is a public institution established to protect financial stability and the rights of deposit/participation-fund holders. Undated corporate page; dated by the year shown in the page footer (2026).

additionalSources.name: Gonca: TMSF Nedir? Mevduat Sigortası Limiti Ne Kadar?
additionalSources.quote: Tasarruf Mevduatı Sigorta Fonu (TMSF), kamu tüzel kişiliğine sahip, idarî ve mali özerkliği bulunan bir kurum.
additionalSources.note: Same article lists trusteeship (kayyımlık) — running companies whose management a court has transferred — among TMSF's five functions, and describes kayyum as the temporary takeover of a company's management by court decision pending investigation.
